**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other solutions or features you thought about.

**Does it belong to PyneIDE?**
PyneIDE is the editor side; the language and runtime semantics live in
[PyneCore](https://github.com/PyneSys/pynecore). If the request is about how
Pyne code *behaves*, it probably belongs there.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots here.
